ash_vow.name: Ash Vow
ash_vow.line: Ash Vow holds the amber and takes a hull that will not pay.

salt_knife.name: Salt Knife
salt_knife.line: Salt Knife cuts tow cables and leaves the buoy dark.

red_penny.name: Red Penny
red_penny.line: Red Penny paints a coin on the bow and hunts haulers.

glass_rat.name: Glass Rat
glass_rat.line: Glass Rat strips lamp glass and runs for the lane.

black_scrip.name: Black Scrip
black_scrip.line: Black Scrip forges a warrant and fires from the copy.
